summary: Daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney
bio: Daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney. Married Murdock "Murt" Dunn (b. 24 Dec 1862) at Plymouth, Pa., on 27 Dec [1886/87] (Luzerne licence 1790). The family emigrated to the Vancouver Island coalfield: in the 1901 Canadian census they were at South Wellington, Nanaimo, B.C. Murdock died in 1901; Cecilia remarried Samuel Wilson at Ladysmith in 1908 and died there in 1918. Children (FS): Thomas (1888-1937), Mary (1890-1935), Edward (1892-1909), Ellen (1894-1969), John Thomas (1897-1955), Murty Vincent (1902-1982). John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
